name: superskillret
description: Embedding-based skill retrieval for Claude Code. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool and injects them as context. v0.2.5: per-session dedup default flipped to OFF — a skill's active framing (e.g. MUST/SHOULD) only stays authoritative while its body is re-injected each turn, so dedup caused inconsistent activation across the same query. Opt in with SUPERSKILLRET_SEEN_TRACKING=1 if you'd rather save tokens. v0.2.4 added daemon lazy-spawn from CLI; v0.2.3 fixed empty-args; v0.2.2 fixed PLUGIN_ROOT + bare-name + skip-duplicate; v0.2.1 lazy install.sh; v0.2.0 custom skill registration.
